accounting.SBC: Future SBC remains fully expensed in GAAP operating margin. Never add back SBC to FCFF. Existing awards are a separate unresolved claim; test a 0–5% equity-value haircut, not assumed fair value. Do not also forecast dilution for the same future compensation.
accounting.R&D: Expensed as reported in base and future margins. No arbitrary R&D asset uplift. Full capitalization would require dated expenditure cohorts, amortization and equal added net reinvestment, preserving cash taxes. This is an explicitly uncapitalized teaching model.
accounting.leases: Lease expense remains an operating cost; lease liabilities excluded from financial debt consistently. No double subtraction.
accounting.taxNOL: Forecast cash-tax proxies transition to 21%; no separate DTA/NOL asset added. Jurisdiction/expiry limitations make aggregate NOL offset invalid.
accounting.reinvestment: Incremental revenue divided by sales-to-capital ratio, excluding R&D already expensed. Negative growth has zero release by default. Procurement commitments flow through future margins/working capital, not wholesale duplicate debt subtraction.
accounting.cash: Subtract 2% of current annual revenue as assumed operating cash via otherClaims; remaining cash/securities added. No independent restriction audit.
accounting.otherClaims: Operating cash only in numeric base bridge; existing equity awards unpriced and acquisition caveats explicit.
accounting.debt: Reported carrying debt is a proxy; no market-value debt reconstruction.

caseSpecific.Arm: Pending $40bn Arm acquisition known at cutoff. This is standalone NVIDIA: excludes future Arm operations, closing cash10bn,44.3m new shares, earnout and employee awards. This omission is material and prevents a fully consolidated transaction valuation; do not assume later completion or failure.
caseSpecific.terminal: Base target margin30%, terminalROIC16%, g2.5%; implied stable reinvestment15.625% of NOPAT. Scenario end-year sales and implied scale must be displayed.

thesis: A cyclical trough with an emerging generative-AI adoption option: recover margins from contemporaneous quarterly guidance and use broad revenue states, without importing later AI sales.

sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Base first-year platform bridge DataCenter+25%,Gaming+5%,remainder+10% gives16.7%,rounded17%. This requires a stronger remainder of year versusQ1 guidance, an explicit recovery judgment.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Q1 FY2024 guidance6,500 revenue,GM64.1%,opex2,530.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Quarter implies25.18% GAAP EBIT margin. Base FY2024 margin28%,bull34%,bear21%; none presents annualization as management full-year guidance.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Inventory and purchase-obligation provisions2,170; architecture transitions complicate demand; supply commitments/prepayments are over half total supply.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Do not normalize all inventory losses to zero forever. Base28% year1 margin already retains ongoing business expenses; capital efficiency2.5 reflects working-capital/supply funding.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Annual filing explicitly discusses generative AI and large language models, but says emerging applications may not produce revenue; DataCenter growth driven by hyperscalers.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Upside acceleration45%,40%,35% is possible-state judgment, not observed demand conversion. Base17% first year remains source-anchored; probabilities uncalibrated.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: China/Russia export-license requirements known; macro and partner inventory corrections ongoing.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Correlated bear combines-8% revenue with21% EBIT margin and slower recovery.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Federal/state/foreign NOL363/329/329; capital-loss carryforward1,380; tax benefit in FY2023.

base.narrative: Channel correction eases and Hopper/AI adoption supports renewed growth; margins recover gradually as inventory burden declines, with competitive fade.

bear.narrative: Export constraints, weak gaming and slower conversion of emerging AI interest to paid capacity leave commitments underutilized.

bull.narrative: Generative AI becomes a large new training/inference workload quickly; CUDA and complete systems capture sustained rents, subject to supply and customers building alternatives.

sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Base next-year platform bridge DataCenter+85%,Gaming+10%,remainder+10% gives68.5%,rounded70%. This is far below repeating217% segment growth.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: One indirect customer approximately19% of annual revenue; China DataCenter revenue14% annual and mid-single-digit share inQ4 following licensing restrictions.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Bear contains a post-backlog capital-spending pause and pricing pressure, rather than assuming uninterrupted market growth.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Inventory/purchase provisions2,200 in each FY2024/FY2023; releases540/137; net margin effect2.7%/7.5%; long-term trajectory of generative-AI demand explicitly unknown.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Retain recurring obsolescence economics; no blanket margin addback. Initial sales/capital3 reflects fabless platform plus working capital, with lower capital efficiency as excess returns fade.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Federal/state/foreign NOL315/342/361 and capital losses1,400 subject to restrictions.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Guided17% tax rises21%; no capital-loss deduction against operating NOPAT or separate tax asset uplift.

bull.narrative: Broad training plus inference demand and system/networking sales sustain rapid deployment; software portability and customer alternatives erode the moat slowly, not immediately.
